_how_to_use: One file controls the promo button on every studio's Instagram link page. Add an entry to show a button; it appears only between start and end (dates are inclusive, studio local time). studios: list of page slugs (e.g. "chandler-north") or "all". url: full link to the promo page. Remove the entry, or let it expire, to hide it.
